description: List tags in the library, optionally only those used within one collection or matching a search. Useful for discovering how a library is organized before filtering zotero_search_items by tag.

collectionKey.description: Only tags used by items in this collection.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-500).

qmode.description: How `q` matches. Ignored when `q` is omitted.

start.description: Zero-based offset for paging; pass the nextStart value from a previous call.

name: zotero_list_tags
title: List tags
